title: EASY DOES IT
subtitle: TWO SEATED MOVES. STEADY AND KIND.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Today is a short seated session. Two easy moves, then we're done. Settle into your chair.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. We'll take it steady.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Stay in the chair. Shake your hands out if you like.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. You can stand when you're ready.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Lift one knee, lower with control. Alternate.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of ten each side. Sit tall, lift one knee, and lower with control.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften your shoulders.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. You're doing well.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Elbows back. Squeeze the shoulder blades. Easy return.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of ten. Elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades, then ease forward.
